user.title: Find a stop
user.description: Choose the data source and enter part of the stop name.

stop.title: Stop and filters
stop.description: All filters are optional and can be changed later under “Configure”.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name of the stop.
data_description.products: Show only trains or only bus/tram/metro.
data_description.lines: Comma-separated, e.g. “S1, REX 7, 5110”. Empty = all lines.
data_description.direction: Comma-separated, part of the destination, e.g. “Villach, Spittal”. Empty = all directions.
data_description.walk_min: Departures you can no longer reach on foot are hidden.
data_description.ahead_min: Only show departures within the next x minutes (up to 24 h).

error.cannot_connect: The timetable service is not reachable right now.
error.no_results: No stop found. Try a different search term.
